_comment: The skill's positive and negative tests. Each brief carries `expect:` in frontmatter; each
`*.proposal.json` is an EXAMPLE of a proposal that keeps the promise, checked by
tools/proposal-check.mjs in the selftest. A real run of the skill is dispatched from a session
(see tests/skill-harness.md); its proposals are checked the same way and the transcripts kept under tests/runs/.

briefs.name: concrete
briefs.why: Three supplied facts, an audience, a length and an ending: every claim can carry a slot and the thesis is given.

briefs.name: underspecified
briefs.why: Topic named, nothing else: the honest outline is four questions and no thesis.
